{{Top|leg}}
'''Razzu''' was a style of [[Music/Legends|music]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a live [[Band/Legends|band]] in the [[Near Vacuum Cantina]] in the floating [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] played a catchy new razzu song just as a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] brawl broke out between a [[Heroes of Cularin|group of freelance agents]] and members of the [[Thaereian military]].<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?">{{LivingForce|Who Goes Thaere?}}</ref>
 
==Behind the scenes==
Razzu appeared in ''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]'', a [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure by [[Ronald A. Heintz]] that formed part of Year Three of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] roleplaying campaign.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
